one_line: Excludes realizable points of the T_65 face with H6 < 0 and H8 < 0 (Thm 1), and with H6 < 0 when p >= b, a, c, d, e > 0 (Cor 2). Every polynomial identity was replayed EXACT, including both full congruences; the argument is sound modulo the HMSV set equality, Prop. C.6 and the negative-Phi theorem (CITED).

statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: T = {0,4,5,6,9,12} = T_65. c = q f2 + p f9 + j f1 + c f45 + e f5 + d f35 + b f0 + a f7 (N_T is simplicial with exactly these 8 generators), coefficients >= 0, d > 0. If H6 < 0 and H8 < 0, where B^2 - 4AC0 = H6 H8 for G = Ap^2 + Bp + C0, then no x in X has c(x) = c with the restored real height. Zero coefficients and Phi = 0 are allowed.

statements.label: Corollary 2
statements.restatement: Same face, coefficients >= 0, a, c, d, e > 0, p >= b. If H6 < 0, there is no realizable lift. This includes H8 = 0, A = 0 and Phi = 0.

dependencies.ref: radial necessity (paper p.27): for x = u + iv in X, C(u) = 0 and det Hess C(u) = 0
dependencies.used_for: G = 0 at every spectrally realizable point, via det H(w(g,-C/Q)) = -4 d^2 G^2/Q^2 (replayed EXACT) and C < 0 (EXACT), so Q != 0 and h = -C/Q

dependencies.ref: HMSV via paper (C.2): {C = det H = 0} = Sigma2-hat (class (b); this document is one of the four listed in foundations/appendix-c-open-items.md Sec. 4.2)
dependencies.used_for: rank <= 12 at points of the perturbed radial graph that are not known to be realizable

dependencies.ref: Corollary C.5 and Proposition C.6 (foundations/appendix-c-part1.md: proved, C.6 modulo standard GIT)
dependencies.used_for: rank <= 12 on Sigma2-hat; nonnegative 12x12 principal minors at H(Re x), one positive at rank 12
